definitions.explanation: The angular distance west of the prime meridian (Greenwich), used to specify locations on the earth's surface.

examples.japanese: ニューヨークは{西経|せいけい}{約|やく}74{度|ど}にある。
examples.english: New York is at approximately 74 degrees west longitude.

examples.japanese: {西経|せいけい}180{度|ど}は{日付変更線|ひづけへんこうせん}にあたる。
examples.english: 180 degrees west longitude corresponds to the International Date Line.

examples.japanese: {南米|なんべい}{大陸|たいりく}の{大部分|だいぶぶん}は{西経|せいけい}35{度|ど}から80{度|ど}の{間|あいだ}に{位置|いち}している。
examples.english: Most of the South American continent is located between 35 and 80 degrees west longitude.

notes:
A geography term composed of {西|にし} (west) and {経|けい} (longitude). Abbreviation: W. The counterpart is {東経|とうけい} (east longitude). Together with latitude ({緯度|いど}), longitude coordinates specify exact positions on the globe.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {西経|せいけい}〜{度|ど} — 〜 degrees west longitude
- {北緯|ほくい}〜{度|ど}{西経|せいけい}〜{度|ど} — latitude 〜° N, longitude 〜° W

RELATED WORDS:
- {東経|とうけい} — east longitude
- {経度|けいど} — longitude (the measurement itself)
- {本初子午線|ほんしょしごせん} — prime meridian (0° longitude, through Greenwich)
